# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first portrait browser strategy game titled **Suburban Heisenboard: Consequence Desk**. Preserve the source mechanics: tap/select a map region, drag-pan the canvas, choose a starting region, accumulate reserve resources over time, convert reserve to force in 5,000-unit increments, open action modals on other regions, use a 60% support/alliance chance, mark enemies on first hostile action, apply repeated pressure with proportional losses, absorb defeated regions, and end the run when player force reaches zero.

Transform presentation into a satirical chemistry/crime escalation world inspired by suburban dread and cartel danger. Use procedural polygon districts instead of a stock map, acid green/mint/red heat colors, an RV/lab focal identity, compact glass HUD panels, readable portrait controls, darkly comic consequence-heavy copy, and mobile-safe touch paths. Do not add new gameplay rules; make the transformation through world semantics, UI language, procedural visuals, feedback, audio, and responsive layout.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The original public surface was a mobile canvas world-map strategy game. The player tapped a region on a map, started from that selected region, gained reserve manpower over time, converted reserves into field army in fixed 5,000-unit increments, opened modals on other regions, chose either a probabilistic support pact or a conflict escalation, repeated pressure against enemies to exchange proportional losses, absorbed defeated regions, and lost if the player's army reached zero.

## Protected mechanics
- Tap/click selects map regions; drag pans the map.
- Menu selection gates the play button until a region is chosen.
- Passive economy ticks approximately once per second.
- Player reserve growth equals base growth plus an area-scaled bonus; non-player regions grow reserves and auto-convert at 6,000 reserve.
- Plus converts 5,000 reserve into 5,000 force; minus converts 5,000 force back into 5,000 reserve.
- Support pact success remains probabilistic with a 60% acceptance threshold.
- First hostile action marks an enemy; repeated hostile action trades losses based on 10% of target force and 15% of player force.
- Target defeat grants area-scaled reserve, resets target force to 1,000, removes enemy status, and adds ally status.
- Player force reaching zero ends the run and shows restart.

## Rebuilt identity
The canonical rebuilt surface is **Suburban Heisenboard: Consequence Desk**, a satirical crime-escalation strategy about a nervous lab-on-wheels expanding across suburban fronts while heat, cartel pressure, and moral collapse intensify. The old world-map premise is transformed into procedural districts, chemical HUD language, cartel/suburban motifs, and mobile portrait controls while the strategic loop remains intact.
